nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for @waggle/hive-mind-hooks-core, the tool-agnostic foundation library that generalizes reversible-install primitives and EventAdapter-parameterized lifecycle handler bodies so consumer hook packages (codex, cursor, hermes, openclaw) stay thin. Depends on @waggle/hive-mind-shim-core and optionally @waggle/hive-mind-cli; published as Apache-2.0 ESM with public access.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript composite build configuration for the hive-mind-hooks-core package, targeting src/ with output to dist/ and declaring a project reference to hive-mind-shim-core to enforce correct build ordering in the monorepo.

nodes.name: tsconfig.test.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for type-checking tests in the hive-mind-hooks-core package; extends the base config with noEmit mode and includes both src/ and tests/ directories without emitting declarations or source maps.
